answer: Verifiable-delay sequencing: each registration must finish a delay function seeded by a fresh pigment reading, taking 1 hour no machine can shortcut. The proof must land on a lantern board before the epoch zenith, and each proof is key-bound, so rented proofs fail. 1,000 identities need 1,000 compute-hours at 50, 50,000 against a 40,000 pool; one machine mints at most 6 per epoch. An honest agent computes once, pays 50 once, keeps a full share.
